8.11.3. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track.generateMissingTrackCircuits¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track.generateMissingTrackCircuits(railyard, TCTypes, delimUserTypes, virtualTCType, namer=None, areaRestriction=None)¶

Generate virtual track circuits covering all edges not contained in any track circuit.

This function returns a list of generated areas of user type virtualTCType. These areas cover all edges in the graph areaRestriction that are not contained in a registered area having user type in TCTypes. The generated areas are delimited by objects having user types in delimUserTypes.

Parameters:
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The railyard we are examining.
  • TCTypes (Iterable(str)) – The user types of track circuits.
  • delimUserTypes (Iterable(str)) – The user types of track circuit delimiters typically corresponding to the TCTypes.
  • virtualTCType (str) – The new type of the generated virtual track circuits.
  • namer (any | none) – A callable having signature (railyard, edge) -> str. namer should return the desired name for the virtual track circuit that will be generated from edge.
  • areaRestriction (IGraph | none) – The area the generated virtual track circuits are restricted to. Default is the full railyard graph.
Return type:

[IGraph]
Returns:

The generated virtual track circuits covering the edges not belonging to a track circuit.
